patch_release_v0.12.1.reason: reclaim_gpu treated any GPU-holding PID outside the container as fatal. RunPod hosts (all 88 1x H100 NVL pods tried for the cookbook Qwen3.6-35B-A3B inference job, and 9 of 13 H200 pods during the Qwen3.8 smoke tests) expose a host-side process holding ~700 MiB; every worker reverted its job and shut down and the cluster re-provisioned indefinitely. Fixed to ignore foreign holders while min_free_fraction is still met.
